cohort: The study included 1,403 cases of childhood leukemia diagnosed between 1981 and 2015 and born in Switzerland between 1969 and 2015, with five controls per case sampled from national birth records matched on date of birth, sex, and municipality of residence at birth.
finding: High birth weight and multiple birth were associated with an increased risk of childhood leukemia, particularly for ALL and leukemia at ages 0-4 years.
followup_time: Up to 15 years of age (leukemia at ages 0-15 years)
birth_weight: High birth weight was investigated as an exposure.
